stem.text: Bread contains a mixture of polypeptides known as gluten.
Two of the polypeptides found in gluten are glutenin and gliadin.
Which statement describes the tertiary structure of a protein?

A.text: Disulfide bonds form between glutenin and gliadin.

B.text: A large proportion of the amino acids in gliadin are glutamine.

C.text: $\alpha$-helical sections are found in glutenin and gliadin.

D.text: Amino acids with hydrophobic R groups are found on the inside of glutenin.
